actors.description: Applicant who owns applications in tenant A.
Reviewer with active membership in tenant A; authority is assignment-scoped.
Tenant_Admin scoped to tenant A via active membership/grant.
Beanola platform operator with platform.* authority across all tenants.

consumption_note: Task 2.2 consumes this as the generated authority-matrix test input: for each endpoint+method, build a request as each actor against an object in tenant A (in-scope / owned), a non-owned object in tenant A, and an object in tenant B (cross-tenant id), then assert the expected allow/deny + HTTP status. Cross-tenant denials MUST be the listed 404/403 disclosure, never a leak.
